title: ipfs mcp agent settings: change event
description: Payload (the SSE data field) of the settings change stream (mcp-agent-settings-api 1.5). The event carries only the new revision; subscribers re-read the settings route to fetch the new state. It never carries settings values or key material.

type.description: Event discriminator. The only event kind on this stream.

revision.description: The new settings revision, equal to the ETag a subsequent GET returns.
